task_class: Formal proof, construction or exact certificate
reason: Can be evaluated without new physical observations; computational cost remains independently assessed.

task_class: Numerical model analysis with controlled error
reason: Can inform a model question; must distinguish numerical evidence from proof and assess compute separately.
Requires provenance, access/license checks, identifiability and appropriate statistical validation.
Potentially in scope with a concrete protocol, equipment list, cost and independent replication plan. No experiment has been run.

task_class: New complex experiment, field campaign, clinical or wet-lab validation
reason: Keep associated theoretical tasks; new empirical work lies outside the current scope.

task_class: Execution of an unbounded computational campaign
reason: Difficult or expensive questions may be indexed. An investigation needs a concrete protocol, resource budget and stopping rules.

task_class: Unfalsifiable speculation or an undefined universal question
reason: Needs a precise claim, credible source and a meaningful validation criterion before admission.

task_class: Purely descriptive historical, clinical, engineering or policy deliverable
reason: Not a theoretical research question under this project scope; formal subproblems may be admitted separately.
